optimized_sql:
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT ss_sold_time_sk, ss_hdemo_sk, ss_store_sk
    FROM store_sales
) AS ss
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT t_time_sk
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE t_hour = 8 AND t_minute >= 30
) AS td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_dep_count = 0
) AS hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE s_store_name = 'ese'
) AS st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
ORDER BY count(*)
LIMIT 100
